title: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.
paragraphs:
Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.
- Proverbs 19:20
Listen to yor pastors and leaders for they only want you to grow spiritually that you may someday will become like them too... followers of Christ Jesus.
I am happy to eat together with Pastor Rey Sanico  and Pastor Julius S. Regala...for when i am with these men of God, i learned and understand more about our kingdom assignment.... thank you so much.
